latest_final: The character has murdered their spouse/partner. To make it look as though the spouse simply walked out and abandoned them, the character forged a farewell note in the spouse's voice — "You've disappointed me so much; I'm never coming back" — written over and over as they kept practising/rewriting the fake message. Now, reviewing the finished note before planting it, they read their own words back and realize with a sinking "Sigh, I know I'm in trouble" that the godnote is in their own handwriting. When the note is found it will be attributed to the spouse, but handwriting analysis will betray the character as the author — proving the note is a forgery and exposing them as the killer.
